items.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
items.desc: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

items.name: Nocturnal 2
items.desc: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

items.name: Punch The Walls
items.desc: Locked in a cell with nothing but your fists. Punch the walls into cubes, vacuum up the rubble and shred it for cash. Upgrade, dig through harder rock, and find the notes the prisoners before you left behind: they hold the code to the door.

items.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator

items.name: ENDER MAGNOLIA: Bloom in the Mist
items.desc: Decades after the events of ENDER LILIES, Homunculi — sorrowful, artificial life forms — roam the land. In this dark fantasy Metroidvania, face formidable enemies and explore a bewitching post-apocalyptic world. Humans and Homunculi — what awaits at the end of the quest for their salvation?

items.name: Dressmaker
items.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: over the hill
items.sub: Funselektor Labs Inc. · Driving, Co-op, Adventure
items.desc: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

items.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
items.desc: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

items.name: One Million Coins
items.desc: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

items.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
items.sub: PaperPixel Games · Casual, Simulation, Online Co-Op
items.desc: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

items.name: Astral Party
items.sub: STAR ENGINE PROJECT · Sexual Content, Hentai, Anime
items.desc: Astral Party is a multiplayer party game populated by cute anime girls! Choose your favorite character, strategize skills & cards, and roll the dice to destroy friendships in this unique board game.

items.name: Rat Game
items.desc: Asymmetrical horror comedy co-op for up to 8 players. Play either a pack of Rats trying to sabotage a restaurant, or the Chef determined to stop them.

items.name: Godius Eternal War
items.desc: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

items.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
items.sub: 上海アリス幻樂団 · Action
items.desc: Dodge the barrage, defeat the enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist Incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics. Control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, weaving between bullets that fill up the screen. The soundtrack has been fully remade by ZUN.

items.name: Aviassembly
items.sub: Jelle Booij · Early Access, Flight, Building
items.desc: Build and fly your own airplane! Complete missions to earn money, upgrade your plane, and discover new locations in an open world.

items.name: Better Than Dead
items.desc: A brutal bodycam revenge FPS set in Hong Kong. Slide into bullet time, fight up close, learn each environment's rhythm, and turn every run into a faster, bloodier revenge scene.

items.name: Rip It! Card Collector
items.desc: A single-player incremental game where you rip boosters and collect cards to complete the ultimate collection. Sell dupes, upgrade your gear and automate your setup to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and gathering all sets. Let's get cracking!

items.name: Thronefall
items.sub: GrizzlyGames · Tower Defense, Strategy, City Builder
items.desc: A minimalist game about building and defending your little kingdom.

items.name: Overhours
items.desc: Overhours is a single-player action tower defense game set in a fictional agency facing an invasion of soul-eating monsters. Work the night owl shift and face the hordes with a variety of traps and special abilities!

items.name: Best Streamer
items.sub: Tamga Games · Action, Simulation, Early Access
items.desc: A ruthless streamer simulation where you'll do anything to reach the top. Grow legally with content or eliminate rivals with weapons. Manage survival needs, use illegal tactics to crush the competition, evade the police, and become the world's number one streamer

items.name: 世界傳記
items.desc: Fantasy RPG that features AP turn-based combat and various RPG nurturing elements, while also offering rich and diverse character storylines that grip the heart.

items.name: Desktop Claw Master
items.desc: Graboo is the shyest claw machine in the world. Graboo quietly picks up doll friends from the corner of the screen while you're working or enjoying games. Give warm friends to Graboo, a loner!

items.name: Malignus
items.desc: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.
